title: Customer Support Representative (remote, entry-level)
text: A partner company is hiring an entry-level customer support representative to answer chats and calls in English and Amharic. No prior experience is required; training is provided. The role can be done from home with a smartphone or computer and a stable internet connection. Ask the assistant to connect you with a person to apply.

title: Data Entry Clerk (part-time)
text: A local business is looking for a part-time data entry clerk to type information from paper forms into a computer system. Basic reading and typing skills are needed. Flexible hours are available, including evenings.

title: Requesting interview accommodations
text: If you need an accommodation for a job interview, such as extra time, a sign language interpreter, materials in a different format, or a quiet room, you can request this without stating a medical condition. Ask the assistant for interview accommodations.
